subject: Deploy Candidate 01 exact horizontal 8:5 geometry
body: Deploy Candidate 01 branch SHA e35f94173f5ba0a784954b3bcdf92e8a49fbadd9 to the local Doré Design resident. This supersedes all earlier Candidate 01 resident deployment requests. Required visible behavior: source cards are horizontal 8:5; each two-column by two-row group resolves to a horizontal 8:5 preview; the preview overlay must be measured from the actual card rectangles and match the group bounds exactly; preserve the original Codrops hover/reverse mechanism; do not restore living-current, mosaic, assemble/release, 4W overlay, or alternate preview geometry.

argv: HTML=$(curl -fsS 'http://127.0.0.1:4310/editor-canvas?page=living-water-candidate-01'); printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'candidate01-exact-grid-preview-geometry' && ! printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'dore-mosaic-layer' && ! printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -q 'candidate-01-living-editorial-runtime'
